name: about-page
title: About page
description: The about page template, built only from library items: the deck's line centered under the light field, a row of creatives, what the company keeps to, the numbers and a way in.
use_for: A website's about page. Edit lib/pages/about.ts or pass `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
Team photos with filters or tints
source: Built from the library (site header, hero block, creative row, card, stat block, button, footer row); Figma page 8: the deck's line (The largest historical record of creative data.); guidelines page 36 (Brand imagery) for what the company keeps to

import { html } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { aboutContent, type AboutContent } from '@/lib/pages/about' import '@/elements/components/ui/button' import '@/elements/components/ui/card' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-row' import '@/elements/components/blocks/hero-block' import '@/elements/components/blocks/stat-block' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // AboutPage.tsx as : the deck's line under the light, a row of creatives, what the company keeps to, the numbers and a way in. `content` replaces the copy. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' /** * @summary The about page template. */ export class AboutPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="about-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy (lib/pages/about.ts by default). */ content: AboutContent = aboutContent render() { const c = this.content ?? aboutContent return html`

${c.beliefs.title}

${c.beliefs.items.map((b) => html``)}

${c.join.title}

${c.join.body}

${c.join.cta.label}
` } } define('about-page', AboutPage)
